name: Bangladesh Railway — station phones and district-wise station counts (Rajshahi Division)
notes: No licence stated. railway.gov.bd publishes no station register (no per-station list with district/code/class); only an 'important stations' BTCL phone list and district-wise station counts in the annual Information Book (2023-24 edition, 1.5 MB PDF, not committed — fetch.py re-downloads it). eticket.railway.gov.bd robots.txt disallows all crawling, so its station list was not used. Timetable/fare files list stops but are not a station registry.
